record.question: Which of the following is false regarding the PLFS Annual Report 2023-24 released by the National Statistical Office (NSO)?
options: A substantial gender gap (12.6%) persists in urban areas.
Ladakh was declared the first fully literate Union Territory in India.
Scheduled Tribes reported 71.3% and Scheduled Castes reported 75.2% literacy, below the national average.
To reach "full literacy" status, a state must cross the 98% literacy threshold.
